name: Darnassus
summary: In Teldrassil’s high boughs, Darnassus shelters the kaldorei as their capital and refuge. Its tranquil groves and waters are the night elves’ spiritual heart and the Alliance’s chief stronghold in northern Kalimdor. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and Archdruid Fandral Staghelm guide their people through the trials of newfound mortality.

sections.title: Sanctuary in the Boughs
sections.body: Darnassus took shape after the Third War, honoring the night elves’ survival after they lost the immortality granted by their sacred World Tree, Nordrassil. Unlike the stone cities of Ironforge and Stormwind, this is an open, tranquil settlement of wood-crafted lodges, glowing shrines, and arched bridges over clear lakes. Vigilant Sentinels, towering ancients of war, and druids who shape trees watch the paths and keep nature’s quiet within the city.

sections.title: A Divided Leadership
sections.body:
Darnassus speaks of kaldorei unity, though its leaders bear different duties. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind handles civil and military affairs from the radiant Temple of the Moon, with the Sisters of Elune around her. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle’s affairs and championed the planting of Teldrassil to restore the elves’ lost immortality.

Malfurion Stormrage is missing, lost in a mysterious slumber within the Emerald Dream. Staghelm’s aggressive vision for the future often clashes with the more patient priesthood.

aliases: who is in charge of darnassus
faq.answer: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind leads night elf society from the Temple of the Moon and commands the Sentinels. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle while Malfurion Stormrage is absent.

faq.q: How do travelers reach Darnassus from outside Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Ships and flight paths from beyond Teldrassil reach Rut'theran Village at the base of the World Tree. From there, a magical portal carries visitors up into Darnassus.

faq.q: Why was Darnassus founded so recently?
faq.answer: After the destruction at Mount Hyjal during the Third War, the night elves lost their immortality and ancient way of life. Fandral Staghelm and his allies planted Teldrassil off Kalimdor’s coast, and Darnassus took root on its branches as a new sanctuary for their people.
Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage is missing, his spirit trapped in a deep, unexplained slumber within the Emerald Dream. In his absence, Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, Darnassus is your people’s cultural and political capital, a fresh start and sovereign refuge after the harrowing sacrifices of the Third War.
For travelers from the Eastern Kingdoms, Darnassus is a secluded, serene haven and the Alliance’s chief stronghold on Kalimdor.
